purpose: Teach: 本紙/減速/同市/出馬/課せ/部類/大綱/適性

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本紙のインタビューに協力されますね
lines.en: The police are cooperating with our newspaper interview, I see.
lines.style: Respectful, formal acknowledgment. Measured cadence with slight upward inflection at the close, as if confirming rather than questioning. Professional distance but genuine recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、繁華街のドライバーに減速を呼びかけられますね
lines.en: And the police are calling for reduced speeds in the downtown district.
lines.style: Continued formal observation. Even tone, unhurried. Adding to a list of points with steady precision. No dramatic emphasis—just noting the facts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、同市の防犯対策を強化されますね
lines.en: They're also strengthening crime prevention measures across the city.
lines.style: Same measured register. Slight vocal tick upward on 'strengthening' to show continuation of the list. Calm, administrative tone. Building a narrative without haste.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民代表が地方選挙に出馬する事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: And handling matters involving citizens running for local office as well.
lines.style: Transitioning smoothly. Voice stays level but slightly slower—this point carries delicate weight. Precise articulation. No judgment, just noting the complexity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警察官に課せる業務量も配慮されますね
lines.en: I notice you're being mindful of the workload placed on younger officers too.
lines.style: Gentle shift in tone. Recognition of care—warmth entering the formality for the first time. Still controlled, but with a quiet note of approval underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、複雑な事件の部類に入る本件、ご対応ありがとうございます
lines.en: This is a complex case, and I truly appreciate your department's response.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude breaking through the formal list. Slower pace. Warmth and respect meeting at the surface. A genuine thank you, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新方針の大綱を市民にもご説明されますね
lines.en: You're also explaining the new policy framework to the public, I understand.
lines.style: Back to formal observation, but carrying the warmth from the previous line. Steady, acknowledging one more substantive point. Professional but now with underlying respect built in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、配属には適性を重視されてますね
lines.en: And when it comes to assignments, you prioritize aptitude.
lines.style: Closing statement—slightly firmer than before. Clear, direct. Appreciative tone underneath. Final observation delivered with quiet conviction, not as question but as recognition.
